svg.text: On the back of each encoder: a row of 3 pins and a row of 2. C and 'push 2' are on the ground-chain page. If a knob turns the wrong way,
flip 'knobs' in the config tab: no rewiring.
Seed3 socket: the jumper-end block in the right wall, from INSIDE (USB-C end on your left)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
pg-1 encoder: RIGHT pin of the row of 3 (A) -> Seed3
pg-1 encoder: LEFT pin of the row of 3 (B) -> Seed3
pg-1 encoder: LEFT pin of the 2 (push) -> Seed3
pg-2 encoder: RIGHT pin of the row of 3 (A) -> Seed3
pg-2 encoder: LEFT pin of the row of 3 (B) -> Seed3
pg-2 encoder: LEFT pin of the 2 (push) -> Seed3
pg-3 encoder: RIGHT pin of the row of 3 (A) -> Seed3
pg-3 encoder: LEFT pin of the row of 3 (B) -> Seed3
pg-3 encoder: LEFT pin of the 2 (push) -> Seed3
pg-4 encoder: RIGHT pin of the row of 3 (A) -> Seed3
pg-4 encoder: LEFT pin of the row of 3 (B) -> Seed3
pg-4 encoder: LEFT pin of the 2 (push) -> Seed3
